label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The first click on the product link by its full name timed out because the same link appears twice in a carousel and the first copy was not clickable; I had to guess to use the second match.

element.name: Retailer AV [name] 9L Shoulder Bag in Citron [name] 9L Shoulder Bag $80

findings.problem: After pressing Add to Cart the page gave no clear confirmation; the cart still read empty with 0 items, and I could not tell whether the item was added.
Opening the cart by its button failed because a free shipping progress heading covered it, although the side cart content was already in the tree.
The cart drawer content stays in the tree all the time, with a Close Side Cart button and a toggle switch with no name for shipping protection, so it is unclear whether the drawer is open or closed.
Several controls have no accessible name: the shipping protection checkbox in delivery, and iframes holding the express payment buttons and card fields, so the payment area is hard to understand.
